title: Birth of the Pandavas
english: The Pandavas were born through divine blessings and were destined to establish Dharma.

title: Dice Game
english: Yudhishthira lost his kingdom in a game of dice because of Duryodhana and Shakuni.

title: Forest Exile
english: The Pandavas spent thirteen years in exile after losing the dice game.

title: Kurukshetra War
english: The great war of Kurukshetra began between the Pandavas and Kauravas.

title: Bhishma's Teachings
english: Bhishma explained Dharma, leadership, justice, and righteous governance to Yudhishthira.
